name: BTAD: beanTech Anomaly Detection Dataset
description: Industrial image anomaly detection and localization benchmark comprising 2,540 high-resolution images across three manufactured industrial products (01: 470 images at 1600x1600, 02: 629 images at 600x600, 03: 1,441 images at 800x600). Captured via factory acquisition systems from beanTech srl, featuring 1,799 defect-free training images and 741 test images (451 normal, 290 anomalous paired with 290 pixel-precise ground truth defect masks, totaling 2,830 image-file assets in the official distribution).

provenance.curation_notes: The official BTAD archive (btad.zip) contains exactly 2,540 product images partitioned into 1,799 training images (all defect-free: 400 in 01, 399 in 02, 1,000 in 03) and 741 test images (451 normal, 290 anomalous: 70 in 01 [21 normal, 49 anomalous], 230 in 02 [30 normal, 200 anomalous], 441 in 03 [400 normal, 41 anomalous]). Accompanying the 290 anomalous test images are 290 pixel-level binary ground truth masks (49 in 01, 200 in 02, 41 in 03), bringing the aggregate image-file count in the distribution to exactly 2,830 (2,540 product images + 290 masks). Literature citing 1,799 describes the training subset only; literature citing 2,830 counts all image files including binary masks; 2,540 is the verified physical product image total.
